subject: Mid‑quarter leadership readout: resource commitments, evidence schedule
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-quarter leadership readout: resource commitments, evidence schedule

Team —

Quick mid‑quarter update and a concrete asks list for the exec readout next week. High level: our Customer API latency OKR is drifting (p50 stable, p95 creeping up), the Dedicated capacity rollout is on track but needs two additional infra FTE-weeks to hit the canary window, and we have outstanding evidence requested by Acme for their compliance review that needs pulls from CS and Product.

Action items I need by EOD Monday:
- Vanessa: confirm whether you can reallocate 2 infra FTE-weeks (or nominate names) for the Dedicated canary window (details in tab 2 of the attached).
- Marissa: provide exact language + metrics we should show for the customer latency narrative (p50/p95 trend, batching gains).
- Kimberly + Naomi: compile the compliance evidence list for Acme (SOC2 scoping, data retention, network topology snapshot). Naomi — can you drive the evidence collection with CS?

Attachments: QBR-evidence-ask.xlsx (tabbed asks and due dates), OKR-heatmap-2026Q4.png (current heatmap).

I know this is a lot in a short window — the goal for the readout is to show a clear remediation plan and resource asks, not perfectly fixed metrics. If we can commit to dates for the infra work and evidence upload to the Drive link below, I’ll fold that into the exec narrative.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B-ExecQBR-Assets

Thanks,
Neha
Neha Kapoor
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter leadership readout: resource commitments, evidence schedule

Neha —

I can free up the 2 infra FTE-weeks but will need to swap a planned infra reliability spike (week of 11/8) down the line; recommend we push that to the following sprint. Proposed nominees: Rishi (lead), Anika (engineer). I’ve added a short note in the Drive (tab 3) with the canary runbook scope.

Also flagged: the Dedicated rollout will temporarily increase cost by ~7% during canary due to parallel capacity. If the exec team asks about unit economics, Marissa — can you include the cost delta in the narrative?

Attaching a quick snapshot of the canary run window and owners.

— Vanessa
Head of Platform Programs

Neha / Vanessa —

Thanks, updated the narrative and added three slides that make the tradeoffs explicit: (1) latency trend + root cause hypothesis, (2) resource ask + canary timeline, (3) customer impact + cost delta. The wording on slide 2 calls out the 2 FTE-weeks and lists Rishi/Anika as owners (happy to change names if infra pushes back).

Regarding the Acme evidence: procurement will want dates. Naomi — can you confirm the earliest we can provide the SOC2 scoping doc and the network topology snapshot? I put placeholders in tab 1 of the spreadsheet: SOC2-scoping (due 11/2), network-topology (due 11/5).

If those dates hold, I’ll finalize the exec pack by Wednesday EOD and circulate for a dry run Thursday.

Marissa
Director, GTM Strategy

- SOC2 scoping doc: I can deliver a first cut by 2026-11-02 (working with CS and security).
- Network topology snapshot (high level): 2026-11-04.
- Data retention table (customer-facing): 2026-11-05.

I don’t expect blockers but note one vendor has a slower turnaround on cert exports (procurement@acme-ops.com will need the vendor signature).
